# sigma_account_type (Resource)

A custom Sigma account type. Built-in account types (admin, creator, explorer, viewer) cannot be managed via this resource — only `is_custom = true` types are mutable. Changing `permissions` updates the account type in place; changing `name` or `description` replaces it (Sigma has no update endpoint for them), which reassigns the type's members to `reassign_to_account_type_id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up the available permissions for a known reference account type.
# Pass the resulting names through to your custom account type.
data "sigma_account_type_permissions" "creator" {
  account_type_id = "<creator-account-type-uuid>"
}

resource "sigma_account_type" "limited_creator" {
  name        = "limited-creator"
  description = "Creators restricted from sharing externally."
  permissions = setsubtract(
    data.sigma_account_type_permissions.creator.permissions,
    ["share_workbook_externally"],
  )
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Human-readable description. Changing it replaces the account type (Sigma has no update endpoint); when `name` also changes it is applied by the rename migration instead.
- `name` (String) Account type name. Sigma has no rename endpoint, so a change is applied by creating the new type, moving its members, and deleting the old one (see `migrate_on_rename`); the account type `id` changes.
- `permissions` (Set of String) Permissions enabled for this account type. Use the names from the `sigma_account_type_permissions` data source. Updated in place.

### Optional

- `migrate_on_rename` (Boolean) Defaults to `true`. When `name` changes, move the type's members to a new type with the new name before deleting the old one, so nobody is reassigned to the delete fallback. Set to `false` to get a plain replace (the old type is deleted and its members go to `reassign_to_account_type_id`).
- `reassign_to_account_type_id` (String) Account type UUID that members of this type are reassigned to on destroy. Sigma's DELETE endpoint requires this even when no members are assigned. Defaults to the built-in `view` account type (`20140502-5fca-4000-8000-000000000004`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Account type UUID.
- `is_custom` (Boolean) Always `true` for resources managed here.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sigma_account_type.example '<account_type_id>'
```
